narrative.overview:
myScrap is a personal capture box, not a knowledge base. The surface is a cool enamel fridge door standing in mixed indoor kitchen light: rubber gasket, stainless handle, cobalt disc magnets, and paper clippings of uneven size. You open the door (sign in or browse), stick something in the freezer-band composer, and it snaps onto the door already tagged.

The product is Operate-mode. Brand lives in material details (gasket, magnets, clipping rotation) while controls stay familiar. Korean and English share one layout. Light theme is locked because enamel under window-plus-overhead light is a pale field; tokens exist so a later dark stainless door could be added without rewriting components.
keyCharacteristics: Cool enamel ground, one cobalt magnet accent
Square clippings, not equal rounded cards
Capture composer first; recency list second
Personal voice: stick, peel, empty the door

rules.name: The One Magnet Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only accent. It marks the thing you can press or the tag that names a type. It does not wash backgrounds or glow.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not pair a Latin display serif or Inter-like default with SUIT. Hangul and English share the same cuts.

rules.name: The Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry offset and blur. A colored halo is not depth.

dos: Speak like a personal box: stick, peel, empty the door, this device.
Show the media itself (image, hover-play, OG, PDF first page).
Label synthetic scraps as Sample / 견본.
Keep KO and EN on one layout.
donts: Build a Notion sidebar of equal cards, or a purple AI chat on cream.
Use Inter, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex, Outfit, Plus Jakarta, DM Sans, or Instrument Sans as the UI face.
Put camera on fine-pointer desktop as a dead control.
Invent team, workspace, or research-lab language.
